items.headline: AESO adds an explanatory link; contracted load figures remain unchanged
items.observed_change: Compared with the archived August 31 page, the September 14 retrieval adds a quick link titled AESO's Role in Data Centre Projects. The page continues to report 1,200 MW allocated, comprising GLDC Load at 970 MW and Keephills Data Centre Phase I at 230 MW. This is a page-content change, not new capacity or realized expenditure. The linked document has not been reviewed.
items.model_implication: Review the explanatory document before considering a documentation update. Retain existing power quantities and acquisition gaps. Executed load contracts do not establish realized construction spending, labour hours, new transmission requirements or public-project delay.
